title: kb-sprint review and close read backlog.py ops
goal: The review and close sections of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md each run python3 _tools/backlog.py ops SP and show its output to the operator; the close retrospective takes its refused dones and failed land steps from it instead of by hand; backlog.md says so, and AGENTS.md stays unchanged.

run:
import re,sys
t=open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
sec={s.split("\n",1)[0].split()[0]:s for s in re.split(r"(?m)^## ",t)[1:]}
miss=[n for n in ("review","close") if not re.search(r"backlog\.py ops\b",sec.get(n,""))]
line=[l for l in sec.get("close","").splitlines() if re.search(r"backlog\.py ops\b",l)]
by_hand="refused" in " ".join(line) and "land" in " ".join(line)
doc=bool(re.search(r"backlog\.py ops\b",open("kb/_self/backlog.md",encoding="utf-8").read()))
print("kb-sprint sections without backlog.py ops:",miss,"| close line names refused dones and land steps:",by_hand,"| backlog.md names it:",doc)
sys.exit(0 if not miss and by_hand and doc else 1)
